title: चतुर्विंशतितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 24 · The Pandavas turn on Drona

summary.en: With the Pandavas turned back, a terrible battle begins as Drona kills Kekayas and Matsyas in numbers. The fighting is wild and varied, with duels in every part of the field.
summary.kn: ಪಾಂಡವರು ಮರಳಿದಾಗ ಭಯಂಕರ ಯುದ್ಧ ಆರಂಭ; ದ್ರೋಣ ಕೇಕಯ, ಮತ್ಸ್ಯರನ್ನು ಅಸಂಖ್ಯ ಕೊಲ್ಲುತ್ತಾನೆ. ರಣರಂಗದ ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ದ್ವಂದ್ವಯುದ್ಧಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋರಾಟ ಉಗ್ರವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: पाण्डवों के लौटने पर भयंकर युद्ध होता है, द्रोण बड़ी संख्या में केकयों और मत्स्यों को मारते हैं। रणभूमि में सब ओर द्वन्द्वयुद्धों के साथ लड़ाई उग्र हो जाती है।
summary.te: పాండవులు తిరిగి రాగా భయంకర యుద్ధం మొదలవుతుంది; ద్రోణుడు కేకయులను, మత్స్యులను అసంఖ్యాకంగా చంపుతాడు. రణభూమిలో అంతటా ద్వంద్వయుద్ధాలతో పోరు తీవ్రమవుతుంది.
summary.ta: பாண்டவர் திரும்பியதும் கொடிய போர் தொடங்குகிறது; த்ரோணர் கேகயரையும் மத்ஸ்யரையும் திரளாகக் கொல்கிறார். களத்தின் எங்கும் தனிப்போர்களுடன் சண்டை தீவிரமாகிறது.
summary.ml: പാണ്ഡവർ പിന്തിരിഞ്ഞതോടെ ഭയങ്കരമായ യുദ്ധം തുടങ്ങുന്നു; ദ്രോണർ കേകയരെയും മത്സ്യരെയും ധാരാളമായി വധിക്കുന്നു. രണഭൂമിയുടെ എല്ലാ ഭാഗത്തും ദ്വന്ദ്വയുദ്ധങ്ങളോടെ പോര് കാട്ടാളമായും വൈവിധ്യമാർന്നും നടക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.24; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
महद्भैरवमासीन्नः संनिवृत्तेषु पाण्डुषु ।
दृष्ट्वा द्रोणं छाद्यमानं तैर्भास्करमिवाम्बुदैः ॥

meaning.en: A great and terrible uproar rose among us when the Pandavas turned back, as we saw Drona covered by them like the sun by clouds.

verses.text:
तैश्चोद्धूतं रजस्तीव्रमवचक्रे चमूं तव ।
ततो हतममन्याम द्रोणं दृष्टिपथे हते ॥

meaning.en: The dust they raised spread thickly over your army, and when Drona passed out of sight we thought him killed.

verses.text:
तांस्तु शूरान्महेष्वासान्क्रूरं कर्म चिकीर्षतः ।
दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनस्तूर्णं स्वसैन्यं समचूचुदत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing those brave great archers set on cruel deeds, Duryodhana quickly urged on his own army.

verses.text:
यथाशक्ति यथोत्साहं यथासत्त्वं नराधिपाः ।
वारयध्वं यथायोगं पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: "Kings, with all your strength, spirit and courage, each as suits his place, hold back the Pandava army."

verses.text:
ततो दुर्मर्षणो भीममभ्यगच्छत्सुतस्तव ।
आराद्दृष्ट्वा किरन्बाणैरिच्छन्द्रोणस्य जीवितम् ॥

meaning.en: Then your son Durmarshana, seeing Bhima from afar, went against him, showering arrows and wishing to save Drona's life.

verses.text:
तं बाणैरवतस्तार क्रुद्धो मृत्युमिवाहवे ।
तं च भीमोऽतुदद्बाणैस्तदासीत्तुमुलं महत् ॥

meaning.en: Furious, he covered Bhima with arrows as Death might, and Bhima in turn pained him with arrows; a great tumult arose.

verses.text:
त ईश्वरसमादिष्टाः प्राज्ञाः शूराः प्रहारिणः ।
बाह्यं मृत्युभयं कृत्वा प्रत्यतिष्ठन्परान्युधि ॥

meaning.en: Those wise and brave strikers, as if commanded by God, set aside the outer fear of death and stood firm against their foes.

verses.text:
कृतवर्मा शिनेः पुत्रं द्रोणप्रेप्सुं विशां पते ।
पर्यवारयदायान्तं शूरं समितिशोभनम् ॥

meaning.en: Kritavarman, O lord of men, blocked the son of Shini, the brave Satyaki, shining in assemblies of warriors, as he advanced eager for Drona.

verses.text:
तं शैनेयः शरव्रातैः क्रुद्धः क्रुद्धमवारयत् ।
कृतवर्मा च शैनेयं मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम् ॥

meaning.en: The angry Shaineya checked Kritavarman with swarms of arrows, and Kritavarman checked Shaineya, like one rutting elephant another.

verses.text:
सैन्धवः क्षत्रधर्माणमापतन्तं शरौघिणम् ।
उग्रधन्वा महेष्वासं यत्तो द्रोणादवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: The Sindhu king, a strong archer, carefully held Kshatradharman, the arrow-showering great archer, back from Drona as he attacked.

verses.text:
क्षत्रधर्मा सिन्धुपतेश्छित्त्वा केतनकार्मुके ।
नाराचैर्बहुभिः क्रुद्धः सर्वमर्मस्वताडयत् ॥

meaning.en: Kshatradharman cut down the Sindhu king's banner and bow and in anger struck every vital spot with many iron arrows.

verses.text:
अथान्यद्धनुरादाय सैन्धवः कृतहस्तवत् ।
विव्याध क्षत्रधर्माणं रणे सर्वायसैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: The Sindhu king took another bow and, like one trained in the art, pierced Kshatradharman in the battle with all-iron arrows.

verses.text:
युयुत्सुं पाण्डवार्थाय यतमानं महारथम् ।
सुबाहुर्भ्रातरं शूरं यत्तो द्रोणादवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Subahu carefully held back his brother, the brave great chariot-warrior Yuyutsu, who strove on the Pandavas' behalf, from Drona.

verses.text:
सुबाहोः सधनुर्बाणावस्यतः परिघोपमौ ।
युयुत्सुः शितपीताभ्यां क्षुराभ्यामच्छिनद्भुजौ ॥

meaning.en: As Subahu shot with bow and arrows like clubs, Yuyutsu cut off both his arms with two sharp, well-whetted razor arrows.

verses.text:
राजानं पाण्डवश्रेष्ठं धर्मात्मानं युधिष्ठिरम् ।
वेलेव सागरं क्षुब्धं मद्रराट्समवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: The Madra king checked King Yudhishthira, best of the Pandavas and righteous in spirit, as the shore checks the stormy sea.

verses.text:
तं धर्मराजो बहुभिर्मर्मभिद्भिरवाकिरत् ।
मद्रेशस्तं चतुःषष्ट्या शरैर्विद्ध्वानदद्भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: The king of dharma covered him with many vital-piercing arrows; the Madra lord pierced him with sixty-four and roared loudly.

verses.text:
तस्य नानदतः केतुमुच्चकर्त सकार्मुकम् ।
क्षुराभ्यां पाण्डवश्रेष्ठस्तत उच्चुक्रुशुर्जनाः ॥

meaning.en: As he roared, the best of the Pandavas cut down his banner and bow with two razor-arrows, and the people shouted.

verses.text:
तथैव राजा बाह्लीको राजानं द्रुपदं शरैः ।
आद्रवन्तं सहानीकं सहानीको न्यवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Likewise King Bahlika, with his army, held back King Drupada as he attacked with his troops, with his own troops.

verses.text:
तद्युद्धमभवद्घोरं वृद्धयोः सहसेनयोः ।
यथा महायूथपयोर्द्विपयोः संप्रभिन्नयोः ॥

meaning.en: Fierce was the battle of those two old men with their armies, like that of two great leaders of herds, rutting elephants.

verses.text:
विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ विराटं मत्स्यमार्च्छताम् ।
सहसैन्यौ सहानीकं यथेन्द्राग्नी पुरा बलिम् ॥

meaning.en: Vinda and Anuvinda of Avanti, with their troops, attacked Virata the Matsya with his army, as Indra and Agni once attacked Bali.

verses.text:
तदुत्पिञ्जलकं युद्धमासीद्देवासुरोपमम् ।
मत्स्यानां केकयैः सार्धमभीताश्वरथद्विपम् ॥

meaning.en: That tangled battle between the Matsyas and Kekayas, with fearless horses, chariots and elephants, was like the war of gods and demons.

verses.text:
नाकुलिं तु शतानीकं भूतकर्मा सभापतिः ।
अस्यन्तमिषुजालानि यान्तं द्रोणादवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Bhutakarman, the president of the assembly, held back Nakula's son Shatanika, who was showering arrow-nets, from reaching Drona.

verses.text:
ततो नकुलदायादस्त्रिभिर्भल्लैः सुसंशितैः ।
चक्रे विबाहुशिरसं भूतकर्माणमाहवे ॥

meaning.en: Then Nakula's heir with three well-sharpened broad-headed arrows left Bhutakarman without arms or head in the battle.

verses.text:
सुतसोमं तु विक्रान्तमापतन्तं शरौघिणम् ।
द्रोणायाभिमुखं वीरं विविंशतिरवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Vivimshati checked the brave Sutasoma, who attacked pouring arrows, as he advanced toward Drona.

verses.text:
सुतसोमस्तु संक्रुद्धः स्वपितृव्यमजिह्मगैः ।
विविंशतिं शरैर्विद्ध्वा नाभ्यवर्तत दंशितः ॥

meaning.en: Furious Sutasoma pierced his own uncle Vivimshati with straight-flying arrows, and armored, did not turn away.

verses.text:
अथ भीमरथः शाल्वमाशुगैरायसैः शितैः ।
षड्भिः साश्वनियन्तारमनयद्यमसादनम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhima's son Bhimaratha sent Shalva, with his horses and charioteer, to Yama's abode with six swift iron arrows.

verses.text:
श्रुतकर्माणमायान्तं मयूरसदृशैर्हयैः ।
चैत्रसेनिर्महाराज तव पौत्रो न्यवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: O great king, your grandson, the son of Chitrasena, held back Shrutakarma as he came with peacock-colored horses.

verses.text:
तौ पौत्रौ तव दुर्धर्षौ परस्परवधैषिणौ ।
पितॄणामर्थसिद्ध्यर्थं चक्रतुर्युद्धमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Those two grandsons of yours, hard to overcome and eager to kill each other, fought a great battle to achieve their fathers' aims.

verses.text:
तिष्ठन्तमग्रतो दृष्ट्वा प्रतिविन्ध्यं तमाहवे ।
द्रौणिर्मानं पितुः कुर्वन्मार्गणैः समवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Prativindhya standing before him in battle, Drona's son, honoring his father's pride, stopped him with arrows.

verses.text:
तं क्रुद्धः प्रतिविव्याध प्रतिविन्ध्यः शितैः शरैः ।
सिंहलाङ्गूललक्ष्माणं पितुरर्थे व्यवस्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: Prativindhya angrily pierced with sharp arrows him, whose banner bore a lion's tail and who stood firm for his father's cause.

verses.text:
प्रवपन्निव बीजानि बीजकाले नरर्षभ ।
द्रौणायनिर्द्रौपदेयं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ॥

meaning.en: Drona's son showered Draupadi's son with rain of arrows, O best of men, like a man scattering seeds in sowing time.

verses.text:
यस्तु शूरतमो राजन्सेनयोरुभयोर्मतः ।
तं पटच्चरहन्तारं लक्ष्मणः समवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Lakshmana, held by both armies to be bravest, held back the slayer of Patachchara.

verses.text:
स लक्ष्मणस्येष्वसनं छित्त्वा लक्ष्म च भारत ।
लक्ष्मणे शरजालानि विसृजन्बह्वशोभत ॥

meaning.en: He cut down Lakshmana's bow and his banner, O Bharata, and shone brilliantly as he loosed nets of arrows at Lakshmana.

verses.text:
विकर्णस्तु महाप्राज्ञो याज्ञसेनिं शिखण्डिनम् ।
पर्यवारयदायान्तं युवानं समरे युवा ॥

meaning.en: The wise Vikarna, young himself, checked the young Shikhandi, son of Yajnasena, as he came on in battle.

verses.text:
ततस्तमिषुजालेन याज्ञसेनिः समावृणोत् ।
विधूय तद्बाणजालं बभौ तव सुतो बली ॥

meaning.en: Then Yajnasena's son covered him with a net of arrows, but your strong son shook off that net of arrows and shone.

verses.text:
अङ्गदोऽभिमुखः शूरमुत्तमौजसमाहवे ।
द्रोणायाभिमुखं यान्तं वत्सदन्तैरवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Angada met the brave Uttamauja in battle as he went toward Drona, and stopped him with calf-tooth arrows.

verses.text:
स संप्रहारस्तुमुलस्तयोः पुरुषसिंहयोः ।
सैनिकानां च सर्वेषां तयोश्च प्रीतिवर्धनः ॥

meaning.en: That fierce clash of those two lions among men delighted both of them and all the soldiers.

verses.text:
दुर्मुखस्तु महेष्वासो वीरं पुरुजितं बली ।
द्रोणायाभिमुखं यान्तं कुन्तिभोजमवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: The strong and mighty archer Durmukha checked the hero Purujit Kuntibhoja as he advanced toward Drona.

verses.text:
स दुर्मुखं भ्रुवोर्मध्ये नाराचेन व्यताडयत् ।
तस्य तद्विबभौ वक्त्रं सनालमिव पङ्कजम् ॥

meaning.en: Purujit struck Durmukha between the brows with an iron arrow, and his face shone like a lotus with its stalk.

verses.text:
कर्णस्तु केकयान्भ्रातॄन्पञ्च लोहितकध्वजान् ।
द्रोणायाभिमुखं याताञ्शरवर्षैरवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Karna held back with showers of arrows the five Kekaya brothers with red banners, who advanced toward Drona.

verses.text:
ते चैनं भृशसंक्रुद्धाः शरव्रातैरवाकिरन् ।
स च तांश्छादयामास शरजालैः पुनः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Furiously angered, they covered him with swarms of arrows, and he covered them again and again with nets of arrows.

verses.text:
नैव कर्णो न ते पञ्च ददृशुर्बाणसंवृताः ।
साश्वसूतध्वजरथाः परस्परशराचिताः ॥

meaning.en: Neither Karna nor the five could be seen, hidden under arrows, their horses, charioteers, banners and chariots all studded with each other's shafts.

verses.text:
पुत्रस्ते दुर्जयश्चैव जयश्च विजयश्च ह ।
नीलं काश्यं जयं शूरास्त्रयस्त्रीन्प्रत्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: Your sons Durjaya, Jaya and Vijaya each held back one of Nila, Kashya and Jaya, three against three.

verses.text:
तद्युद्धमभवद्घोरमीक्षितृप्रीतिवर्धनम् ।
सिंहव्याघ्रतरक्षूणां यथेभमहिषर्षभैः ॥

meaning.en: That battle was terrible, delighting all who watched, like a fight of lions, tigers and bears against elephants, buffaloes and bulls.

verses.text:
क्षेमधूर्तिबृहन्तौ तौ भ्रातरौ सात्वतं युधि ।
द्रोणायाभिमुखं यान्तं शरैस्तीक्ष्णैस्ततक्षतुः ॥

meaning.en: The two brothers Kshemadhurti and Brihanta tore at the Satvata, Satyaki, with sharp arrows as he went toward Drona.

verses.text:
तयोस्तस्य च तद्युद्धमत्यद्भुतमिवाभवत् ।
सिंहस्य द्विपमुख्याभ्यां प्रभिन्नाभ्यां यथा वने ॥

meaning.en: Their fight with him was marvelous indeed, like that of a lion with two chief rutting elephants in a forest.

verses.text:
राजानं तु तथाम्बष्ठमेकं युद्धाभिनन्दिनम् ।
चेदिराजः शरानस्यन्क्रुद्धो द्रोणादवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: The Chedi king, shooting arrows, angrily checked from Drona the Ambashtha king, who alone delighted in battle.

verses.text:
तमम्बष्ठोऽस्थिभेदिन्या निरविध्यच्छलाकया ।
स त्यक्त्वा सशरं चापं रथाद्भूमिमथापतत् ॥

meaning.en: The Ambashtha pierced him with a bone-splitting shaft, and the Chedi king dropped his bow and arrows and fell from his chariot to the ground.

verses.text:
वार्धक्षेमिं तु वार्ष्णेयं कृपः शारद्वतः शरैः ।
अक्षुद्रः क्षुद्रकैर्द्रोणात्क्रुद्धरूपमवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Kripa, son of Sharadvat, noble, held back Vardhakshemi, the Vrishni, as he angrily attacked Drona, with small arrows.

verses.text:
युध्यन्तौ कृपवार्ष्णेयौ येऽपश्यंश्चित्रयोधिनौ ।
ते युद्धसक्तमनसो नान्या बुबुधिरे क्रियाः ॥

meaning.en: Those who watched Kripa and the Vrishni fighting, both wonderful fighters, were so absorbed that they noticed nothing else.

verses.text:
सौमदत्तिस्तु राजानं मणिमन्तमतन्द्रितम् ।
पर्यवारयदायान्तं यशो द्रोणस्य वर्धयन् ॥

meaning.en: Somadatta's son tirelessly checked King Manimat as he came on, increasing Drona's fame.

verses.text:
स सौमदत्तेस्त्वरितश्छित्त्वेष्वसनकेतने ।
पुनः पताकां सूतं च छत्रं चापातयद्रथात् ॥

meaning.en: Swiftly Manimat cut down Somadatta's son's bow and banner, and again threw down his pennant, his charioteer and his umbrella from the chariot.

verses.text:
अथाप्लुत्य रथात्तूर्णं यूपकेतुरमित्रहा ।
साश्वसूतध्वजरथं तं चकर्त वरासिना ॥

meaning.en: Then Yupaketu, slayer of foes, leapt from his chariot and cut that chariot to pieces with its horses, charioteer and banner with a fine sword.

verses.text:
रथं च स्वं समास्थाय धनुरादाय चापरम् ।
स्वयं यच्छन्हयान्राजन्व्यधमत्पाण्डवीं चमूम् ॥

meaning.en: Mounting his own chariot and taking another bow, driving the horses himself, O king, he destroyed the Pandava army.

verses.text:
मुसलैर्मुद्गरैश्चक्रैर्भिण्डिपालैः परश्वधैः ।
पांसुवाताग्निसलिलैर्भस्मलोष्ठतृणद्रुमैः ॥

meaning.en: With clubs, mallets, discs, slings and axes, with dust, wind, fire and water, with ashes, clods, grass and trees,

verses.text:
आरुजन्प्ररुजन्भञ्जन्निघ्नन्विद्रावयन्क्षिपन् ।
सेनां विभीषयन्नायाद्द्रोणप्रेप्सुर्घटोत्कचः ॥

meaning.en: breaking, shattering, smashing, striking, scattering and hurling, Ghatotkacha came terrifying the army, eager to reach Drona.

verses.text:
तं तु नानाप्रहरणैर्नानायुद्धविशेषणैः ।
राक्षसं राक्षसः क्रुद्धः समाजघ्ने ह्यलम्बुसः ॥

meaning.en: The Rakshasa Alambusa angrily struck that Rakshasa with many weapons and many special kinds of fighting.

verses.text:
तयोस्तदभवद्युद्धं रक्षोग्रामणिमुख्ययोः ।
तादृग्यादृक्पुरा वृत्तं शम्बरामरराजयोः ॥

meaning.en: Their battle, between two chiefs of the Rakshasas, was like the battle once fought between Shambara and the king of the gods.

verses.text:
एवं द्वंद्वशतान्यासन्रथवारणवाजिनाम् ।
पदातीनां च भद्रं ते तव तेषां च संकुलम् ॥

meaning.en: So there were hundreds of duels between chariots, elephants, horses and foot soldiers, in a crowd of your men and theirs, blessings on you.

verses.text:
नैतादृशो दृष्टपूर्वः संग्रामो नैव च श्रुतः ।
द्रोणस्याभावभावेषु प्रसक्तानां यथाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Such a battle was never seen or heard of before, as it came about among those devoted to Drona's life or death.

verses.text:
इदं घोरमिदं चित्रमिदं रौद्रमिति प्रभो ।
तत्र युद्धान्यदृश्यन्त प्रततानि बहूनि च ॥

meaning.en: This was dreadful, this was strange, this was fierce, my lord; many extended fights could be seen there.
